name: Doe, et al. v. Siskiyou Hospital, Inc. d/b/a Fairchild Medical Center (Pixel Privacy Settlement)
summary: Settlement resolving claims that Fairchild Medical Center's website tracking pixels disclosed patients' private information to third parties without consent. California class members can claim $25 cash with no proof, plus a year of identity/privacy protection services.

eligibilityQuestions.text: Did you visit or use Fairchild Medical Center's website or patient portal?
